title: 36 Hours in Barcelona, Spain
abstract: In the Catalan capital, tuna belly is painted with jamón fat, new galleries surface in the shadow of Gaudí and children play around the Magic Fountain.

title: 36 Hours in Hyderabad, India
abstract: This 400-year-old city offers seductive history, fiery food, wallet-friendly jewelry and a dynamic high-tech scene.

title: 36 Hours in Napa Valley
abstract: The array of sensory indulgences here can make you dizzy before you’ve even had your first glass of local wine.

title: 36 Hours in Dresden, Germany
abstract: In this city on the Elbe, once known as the “Florence of the North,” cultural treasures, lively restaurants and trendy shops coexist with the residue of a dark history.

title: 36 Hours in Oxford, England
abstract: In this town, it starts with learning. Centuries of it. But if that’s too tweedy for you, don’t worry. You can also find Harry Potter, Michelin-starred dining, live music and more.
